correctness.rationale: Exact rational substitution verifies the printed-system equilibrium and total-population law. Exact determinant expansion factors the characteristic determinant into the delay-independent mode and the stated reduced equation. The imaginary-root polynomial is strictly increasing on positive u and has one positive root; exact Routh-Hurwitz at zero delay plus a positive implicit crossing speed establishes the first linear loss of stability. The packaged verifier replays these computations.
